$comment: Known violations of scripts/check-composition-container-literal.mjs (RFC-043, owner ruling 2026-10-01: ALLOW the containerId literal for now, as an enforced allowlist tied to srs#851). Entry shape: {path, pointer, containerId, reason, disposition, issue}, the same discipline as scripts/repository-cell-allowlist.json; pointer is the JSON pointer to the container-subset source object. The check fails on any literal NOT listed here (so a new literal fails) and on any entry that no longer matches a literal (shrinking this file IS the fix). srs#851 removes the literals from the spec Compositions and the gallery example and then deletes this file and its checks.json registry entry. Measured 2026-10-01: 18 sites in the two spec Compositions, 3 in the gallery example package, 3 in the gallery.srsj archive (24).
